name: imot2026 deploy sync never copies local secrets or workflow state, and fails fast on a stalled connection
description: The deploy's rsync of the controller checkout to vm700 (roles/ops-settings/tasks/imot2026.yaml, 'Sync the imotbgScraper2026 working tree to vm700') excluded .git, node_modules, coverage, work, protected and .claude, but not the gitignored .secrets/ (a local session env file), .state/ (243 MB of workflow suite logs), .scratch-local/, .wf/ or reports/. On 2026-09-17 .secrets/ was found copied to /opt/imot2026/src-tree/.secrets on vm700 (not in the image: the Dockerfile copies named directories only). The same deploy spent about two hours in this sync step with no timeout (00:20-02:26Z) while the image build took 1m07s.

changes: rsync_opts gain --exclude for .secrets, .state, .scratch-local, .wf and reports, and --timeout=300 so a stalled transfer fails instead of hanging the deploy

checks: rsync --dry-run with the exact new options from the controller checkout into an empty directory: 3,625 items; 0 under .secrets, /.state, /.wf, /reports, /.scratch-local; docs/reports 9, web/src 305, src/dedup/perceptual.ts present
same dry run against vm700:/opt/imot2026/src-tree/: exit 0, nothing to transfer (tree already current), nothing deleted
